evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
evidence.PF OA: Focal cartilage defect over medial facet and patellear ridge and mild subchondral edema and small spur foramtion, reflecting grade 4 chondromalacia. Wearing of articular cartilage of femoral trochlea, reflecting grade 2-3 chondromalacia.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
